fullPassage:
With wild fish stocks gradually declining due to overfishing and the changing climate, more fishers are turning to farming instead of casting nets or lines.

(A) With the arrival of smart fish farming technology driven by artificial intelligence (AI), fish farmers are able to provide healthy, affordable seafood to families everywhere.

(B) In fact, according to a UN report, about 49% of the fish consumed worldwide in 2020 came from fish farms, not from the wild. This figure is expected to continue to grow, increasing to 62% by 2030.

(C) An essential element in providing healthy fish to consumers is the fish farmers` ability to detect and prevent sea lice, a significant threat to fish health and profitability.

questions.passage: Traditionally, fishers went out to sea with fishing nets or long lines on boats to catch fish. They took advantage of their experience ⓐ <u>gained</u> through trial and error, through observation, and through knowledge ⓑ <u>passed</u> down from previous generations. With wild fish stocks gradually ⓒ <u>declining</u> due to overfishing and the changing climate, more fishers are turning to farming instead of ⓓ <u>cast</u> nets or lines. In fact, according to a UN report, about 49% of the fish ⓔ <u>consumed</u> worldwide in 2020 came from fish farms, not from the wild.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

det.korean: 그물이나 줄을 던지는 대신. 전치사 instead of 뒤에는 동명사(v-ing)가 와야 합니다. cast(동사원형)는 전치사의 목적어 자리에 올 수 없으므로 casting으로 고쳐야 합니다. ⓐ gained: experience를 수식하는 과거분사(경험은 얻어지는 것 → 수동) ✅ ⓑ passed: knowledge를 수식하는 과거분사(지식은 전해지는 것 → 수동) ✅ ⓒ declining: with + O + v-ing(부대상황, 능동) ✅ ⓔ consumed: fish를 수식하는 과거분사(수동) ✅
det.analysis: 원문: instead of casting nets or lines
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: A computer system with deep learning capabilities is able to track and record fish behavior better than humans can, especially when the system is trained with enough relevant data. It can distinguish and identify one fish from (A) <u>[another / the other]</u> and diagnose whether a small speck is dirt or sea lice, and this information is entered into the fish`s health record. Farmers can then determine when they should take action, such as when to separate an abnormal group from the rest or spread out the fish population (B) <u>[reduce / to reduce]</u> density, without (C) <u>[resorting / resorted]</u> to harsh chemical treatments.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 한 마리 물고기를 다른 한 마리와 구별 / 밀도를 줄이기 위해 / 거친 화학 처리에 의존하지 않고. (A) one ~ another: 불특정 다수 중 하나와 또 다른 하나 대비. (B) to reduce: 목적의 to부정사. (C) without + v-ing: 전치사 뒤 동명사.
det.analysis: 원문: one fish from another / to reduce density / without resorting to
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: The system can also tell farmers exactly when to feed the fish by ⓐ <u>identifying</u> patterns of behavior that an individual fish or the school exhibits when they are hungry. This is how farmers can accurately determine optimal feeding times and amounts. The right amount of food at the right time minimizes cost, ⓑ <u>reduces</u> waste and pollution, and maximizes fish growth rates. ⓒ <u>Given</u> the fact that feeding constitutes more than 50% of a fish farm`s operational budget, this precise feeding approach will ultimately contribute to a more affordable supply of fish for consumers as well as efficient and ⓓ <u>sustaining</u> aquaculture operations in general.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

det.korean: 효율적이고 지속 가능한 양식 운영. sustaining(현재분사)은 '~을 유지하는'이라는 능동 의미이고, sustainable(형용사)은 '지속 가능한'이라는 확립된 형용사입니다. efficient(형용사)와 병렬이므로 형용사 sustainable이 적절합니다.
det.analysis: 원문: efficient and sustainable aquaculture operations
det.tip: 어법 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: An essential element in providing healthy fish to consumers is the fish farmers` ability to detect and (A) <u>[prevent / promote]</u> sea lice, a significant threat to fish health and profitability. One of the most modern methods to do this is through the power of computer vision and precision sensors, allowing fish farmers to (B) <u>[identify / ignore]</u> and track diseases before they spread. An aquaculture system equipped with high-precision underwater tools has already been (C) <u>[developed / abandoned]</u> in Norway.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 바다이를 탐지하고 예방하다 / 질병을 식별하고 추적 / 노르웨이에서 이미 개발됨. (A) sea lice는 위협이므로 prevent(예방). (B) 질병을 track하기 전에 identify(식별). (C) 첨단 시스템이 개발되었다는 긍정적 맥락.
det.analysis: 원문: detect and prevent sea lice / identify and track diseases / has already been developed in Norway
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: The system can also tell farmers exactly when to feed the fish by identifying patterns of behavior that an individual fish or the school ① <u>exhibits</u> when they are hungry. This is how farmers can accurately determine ② <u>optimal</u> feeding times and amounts. The right amount of food at the right time minimizes cost, reduces waste and pollution, and ③ <u>maximizes</u> fish growth rates. Given the fact that feeding ④ <u>constitutes</u> more than 50% of a fish farm`s operational budget, this precise feeding approach will ultimately ⑤ <u>hinder</u> a more affordable supply of fish for consumers.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 궁극적으로 더 저렴한 어류 공급에 기여할 것이다. 원문 contribute to(기여하다)가 ⑤ hinder(방해하다)로 바뀌어 문맥에 맞지 않습니다.
det.analysis: 원문: will ultimately contribute to a more affordable supply
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: AI continues to advance in aquaculture to extend beyond caged fish. In particular, smart fish farming technologies can be ① <u>applied</u> to seaweed farming. Seaweed is as ② <u>valuable</u> a source of food as fish. Using cameras and sensors, AUVs can do many of the ③ <u>analytical</u> and diagnostic tasks on seaweed farms. Swarm robots, or many small robots working together, can swim in and around seaweed farms to ④ <u>collect</u> data and then make decisions on how to deal with problems that arise. Single larger robots or even humans may be available to take care of the physical labor; however, swarm robots may be more ⑤ <u>inefficient</u> and cost-effective.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 군집 로봇이 더 효율적이고 비용 효과적일 수 있다. 원문 efficient(효율적인)가 ⑤ inefficient(비효율적인)로 바뀌어 문맥 반대.
det.analysis: 원문: swarm robots may be more efficient and cost-effective
det.tip: 어휘 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

questions.passage: With the arrival of smart fish farming technology driven by artificial intelligence (AI), fish farmers are able to provide healthy, affordable seafood to families everywhere. An essential element in providing healthy fish to consumers is the fish farmers` ability to detect and prevent sea lice, a significant threat to fish health and profitability. One of the most modern methods to do this is through the power of computer vision and precision sensors, allowing fish farmers to identify and track diseases before they spread.

det.analysis: 원문: smart fish farming technology driven by artificial intelligence (AI)
det.tip: 대의 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.

det.analysis: 원문: AI in aquaculture is vast / sustainable and technologically driven future / AI as an ally

questions.passage: An aquaculture system equipped with high-precision underwater tools has already been developed in Norway. It can hold up to 150,000 salmon in a sea cage, regularly inducing each fish into a tube where high-resolution cameras and sensors record everything about each individual salmon, including their overall shapes and dot patterns, their weight and growth rate, as well as any signs of sea lice, physical wounds, or abnormalities. questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.

A computer system with deep learning capabilities is able to track and record fish behavior better than humans do.

det.korean: 인간이 할 수 있는 것보다 더 잘. is able to(능력)를 받아 비교 대상에서도 능력의 조동사 can 필요. do(단순 대동사)가 아닌 can(능력)이 적절.
det.analysis: 원문: better than humans can
det.tip: 서술형 유형 — 지문을 꼼꼼히 읽고 정답을 찾으세요.
